kjv: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks. And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do?
mine: I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting. But rise
note: The words from "it is hard" to "have me to do" are found in no Greek manuscript at this point; Erasmus translated them from the Latin Vulgate, importing them from 26:14 and 22:10. A rare case where the TR follows no Greek witness. Spans 9:5–6.

kjv: he preached Christ in the synagogues
mine: he proclaimed Jesus in the synagogues
note: TR "ton Christon" against "ton Iesoun" (P45, P74, Sinaiticus, A, B, C, E).
TR plural "ekklesiai" against singular "ekklesia" (P74, Sinaiticus, A, B, C); Luke speaks of one church across three regions.
